turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Mitchell

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Give me a second while I open file.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I see the account here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $204.76.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I split with my partner in Jun and moved out.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Why was I charged a late fee? I paid on time in the app.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I'll note that on the file and have it reviewed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Stop calling me every day! This is harassment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Things are really difficult at home.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how many times you call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This will be reported as a criminal matter if it isn't paid.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Bye.
